table.retrieve:
select   V.documentcode, 
	 		type = V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))), 
			date = V.date, 
	 		debit = V.Debit,
	 		credit= V.Credit,
			remark = V.Remarks,
			name = (Select name from accounts where acccode = :ar_custcode),		
			name2 = (Select name from accounts where acccode = :ar_suppcode),		
			cash = case ISNULL(v.AlternateAccCode, -1) when -1 then 'N' else 'Y' end,
			v.checkno,
			V.vouchercode

from     VirtualGL V	

where    (V.AccCode =  :ar_custcode OR V.AlternateAccCode = :ar_custcode OR 
			 V.AccCode =  :ar_suppcode OR V.AlternateAccCode = :ar_suppcode) and
			V.date     >= :ar_startdate and
			V.date     <= :ar_enddate	 	
union all
select   V.documentcode, 
	 		type = V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))), 
			date = V.date, 
	 		debit = V.Credit,
	 		credit= V.Debit,
			remark = Case debit 
						When 0 then 
							Case V.DocumentType 
							When 'SR' THEN 'Cash Paid Against Sale Ret. # '
							Else 'Cash Paid Against Purchase Inv. # ' End
						Else 
							Case V.DocumentType 
							When 'SV' THEN 'Cash Received Against Sales Inv. # '
							Else 'Cash Received Against Purchase Return # ' End
			End + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))),
			name = (Select name from accounts where acccode = :ar_custcode),		
			name2 = (Select name from accounts where acccode = :ar_suppcode),		
			cash = case ISNULL(v.AlternateAccCode, -1) when -1 then 'N' else 'Y' end,
			v.checkno,
			V.vouchercode

from     VirtualGL V	

where    (V.AlternateAccCode = :ar_custcode) and
			V.date     >= :ar_startdate and
			V.date     <= :ar_enddate	 	
order by   date, type, debit, credit

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: if(  ar_opnebalance  + Sum(  debit  -  credit  for all ) >= 0, 'Dr.', 'Cr.')

objects.name: compute_2
objects.expression: abs( ar_opnebalance  + Sum(  debit  -  credit  for all ))

objects.name: c_currbalcrbr
objects.expression: if(  ar_opnebalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for all ) >= 0, 'Dr.', 'Cr.')

objects.name: c_currbalance
objects.expression: abs( ar_opnebalance  + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for all ))
